name: GoHighLevel Conversations
verified_note: Template. HighLevel Conversations is a React SPA; run the verify flow against a real location, record the selectors that actually match, and set verified to the date. No OAuth token, private integration token, API key, or cookie belongs in this file.
auth: Browse MCP reuses the already-logged-in Chrome profile. The user must be signed in and the correct sub-account/location must be selected. Never store HighLevel credentials, tokens, or cookies here.

policy.sends: Start with autonomy=suggest or approve. Do not auto-send on an unverified browser connector.
policy.disclosure: The agent must not pretend to be human. Keep the workspace AI label and follow the account's disclosure policy.
policy.no_stealth: No fingerprint spoofing, random delays, fake typing, proxy rotation, or other mimicry to evade HighLevel's automation checks.

verify: navigate {inbox} with the real location_id; wait for the conversation list to render
browse.snapshot --interactive; for each selector above, record whether it returns 0 or more nodes
open one harmless test conversation; confirm message ids/timestamps, composer, channel control, internal-note control and send button
update this file with what actually matched; set verified to the date
dry-run read_thread only; do not send during verification
read_inbox: navigate {inbox}; wait until the conversation list has rows
use the Unread filter if present; otherwise scan All. Do not trust the unread count badge
for each row capture: contact name, channel icon/text, snippet, unread state, relative time, and conversation id from data-conversation-id or the row link
keep scrolling until lazy loading stops; stop at 200 rows and report rather than looping
compare rows with `relay queue` and `relay thread <id>`; only open new or changed conversations
read_thread: click the conversation row; do not rely on {thread} to deep-link — HighLevel conversation URLs are known not to open the selected thread
wait for the message list; snapshot the whole conversation pane
for each message capture: direction, author, exact timestamp, body, channel, attachment names, and data-message-id if present
if no stable message id or exact timestamp exists, stop and report; do not write a snapshot
build the normalised shape in examples/gohighlevel-browser-snapshot.json (thread id = conversation id, external_id = message id)
run `relay sync --stdin` with the snapshot; never hand-edit messages after ingest
watch: every 120 seconds during support hours, run read_inbox
open up to 10 changed conversations and run read_thread for each
emit one normalised snapshot and run `relay sync --stdin`
run `relay brief` and `relay queue`; draft only, never send in the watch run
one watch run at a time; use a lock like examples/on-change.sh
if any thread lacks stable message ids/timestamps, stop the whole run rather than risk duplicates
send_reply: confirm the location and contact; open the conversation row
confirm the last inbound channel (SMS/email/WhatsApp/FB/IG/live chat); check DND/opt-out before composing
confirm the Internal note toggle is OFF; if the UI cannot prove it, stop
click the composer and type the approved text (fill may not fire React input events); for email confirm subject and recipients
read the rendered text and compare it to the approved text; check for unresolved placeholders
click Send; wait_for the sent text in the thread
only then run `relay send <thread> --text '<exact text>'` and pass --commit/--commit-due if a promise was made
add_note: switch the composer to Internal note; confirm the mode visually
record it with `relay log <thread> --kind note --text '<exact note>'`
never leave a note in the customer reply mode
read_context: open {contact}; read tags, owner, timezone, DND state, and the related opportunity
open {opportunities} and read pipeline, stage and value
do not edit stage, value, owner, tags or DND; those are human decisions or another system's data
record anything that changes the reply with `relay log <thread> --kind note`

watch.missing_id_policy: stop and report; do not ingest

quirks: Conversations is a React SPA; prefer role/text/data-* locators over CSS classes and re-verify after HighLevel releases.
Conversation URLs exist (…/conversations/conversations/{id}) but are known not to reliably open that conversation; drive the inbox row instead.
The inbox is unified: SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and live chat share one list. Confirm the channel before promising a response time.
The composer is usually contenteditable; fill may not dispatch input events, so type and then read the rendered text.
Internal note/comment and customer reply share the same composer area; confirm the mode before every submit.
DND/opt-out and SMS quiet hours apply. A contact can be present in the inbox but still not messageable.
Email replies need a subject and may thread differently; SMS counts segments and can split a long reply.
Conversation AI/Workflows may have already answered; read the full thread before adding a human reply.
Attachment uploads and media messages are asynchronous; do not submit until the upload settles.
Agencies have multiple sub-accounts/locations. The wrong location id is the wrong customer; verify it before reading.
Rows lazy-load; scan until the list stops growing instead of trusting the first page.
Relative timestamps and missing message ids break idempotent ingest; capture exact time/ID or stop.
guardrails: Never send with the internal-note toggle on; verify the customer-facing mode visually before submit.
Never message a DND/opted-out contact or ignore SMS quiet hours.
Do not reply in a conversation assigned to another user without an explicit handoff note.
Do not edit opportunity stage/value, contact owner, tags or DND; read them into context only.
Use the channel of the last inbound message unless the customer explicitly asks otherwise.
Do not hide that the agent is an AI; keep the workspace label and follow the disclosure policy.
No stealth: no fingerprint spoofing, proxy rotation, random delays, fake typing, or other detection evasion.
Check HighLevel's terms and the agency agreement before enabling browser automation; accounts can be restricted.
If a thread has no stable message id/timestamp in the DOM, stop the watch; do not fall back to relative times.
Voicemail, calls and attachments are not text messages; escalate rather than pretending you listened or read them.
